Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: isolated transparent inventory item for a restrained five-tier emerald shop in the woodland fantasy card game Sylve.
Reference image 1: STYLE AND MATERIAL reference, and the UPPER LIMIT of richness for the final tier in the whole set. This requested asset is a SMALLER, SIMPLER earlier tier. Match its polished hand-painted fantasy brushwork, brown oak/leather, muted antique brass, faceted vivid GREEN emeralds and soft warm highlights. Redesign the subject as described below rather than copying the large chest.
Composition: one complete centered object in three-quarter view, square image, full silhouette, 12 percent transparent padding, consistent slightly elevated viewing angle, readable at 180px. Grounded plausible handheld proportions and restrained materials. Keep all gems green. Emeralds are ordinary small gemstones, not gigantic boulders. Very subtle gem highlights.
Constraints: real transparent alpha background. No environment or floor, no UI, no text or lettering, no watermark, no people, no crown, no royal symbols, no multiple containers, no mountains of gems, no huge treasure piles, no coins. A single modest container and a few gems only.
Subject: Tier 1 of 5: a SMALL plain walnut-brown soft leather drawstring coin purse, slightly open to reveal only five or six small emerald gemstones. One tiny loose emerald beside it. Simple cord, a small brass eyelet, no decoration. An inexpensive humble purse, rounded compact silhouette, very little treasure.
